description: Federal income tax for tax year 2027 (or 2026) on an income, using the IRS rate schedule: subtracts the standard or itemized deduction (with the age and blindness extra), applies the brackets, returns the bracket-by-bracket breakdown, marginal and average rate, optional long-term capital gains taxed at 0, 15 or 20 percent, and the tax on the same facts under the other year. Federal income tax only; no credits, self-employment tax, NIIT, AMT or state tax.

additional_deductions.description: Other deductions that reduce taxable income, for example the qualified business income deduction, worked out by you.

age_65_or_older_count.description: Filers 65 or older by December 31, for the standard deduction extra.

blind_count.description: Blind filers, for the standard deduction extra.

income.description: Gross income or AGI before the deduction. Give this or taxable_income.

itemized_deductions.description: Total itemized deductions, required when deduction is itemized.

long_term_capital_gains.description: Long-term capital gains and qualified dividends included in taxable income, taxed at the preferential rates.

taxable_income.description: Taxable income after the deduction. Give this or income.

name: calculate_federal_income_tax
title: Calculate federal income tax
